verdict.rationale: The evidence shows individual document access, such as downloading uncertified patent copies and the TSDR documents tab. It never documents a way to export all of a user's account data, filings, docket or payment records in open formats, or to close the account and leave. Per-document retrieval of public records is an adjacent feature, not the export-and-leave capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
